notes.title: Updates since the first early access version
notes.notes:
An incomplete list to sum up the main topics we were working on and got into the builds since the release of the first early access version:

 more animals to hunt
 animals that can fly
 more buildable structures, including some that you can use to protect your shelters
 structures can be repaired
 more craftable objects
 more usable weapons
 a drone slider vehicle
 inventory handling upgraded
 more emblematic sceneries
 underwater life: fish
 AI behavior tuning and enhancements
 head up indicator enhancements
 player character upgrade: completely new animations and player graphics
 performance tuning
 gameplay balanced
 bugs fixed


For a more detailed list please check the update notes below!

notes.title: Update #1 - v0.663
notes.notes:
We have uploaded an update which includes the following changes:

 FEATURE Built save points (tents, houses, watchtowers, etc.) shows a location indicator on screen. This can be disabled and re-enabled by pressing H.
 FEATURE Hotkeys for weapons and light sources bound to the alphanumeric buttons.
 FIX When an item was selected from the "object notes" and not from the "backpack" then the use button was not working properly.
 FIX Sometimes the sky was flickering in the distance.
 FEATURE Object pickup icon now includes a small image of the object to help identify smaller items.
 FEATURE When placing a structure placeholder the controls are indicated.
 FEATURE Dissolving objects now have a progress bar in the inventory after their first use.
 FIX Use and drop buttons always choose objects with the shortest dissolve time.
 FEATURE Night vision effect is indicated with a progress bar on the HUD.
 FEATURE Stamina boost and crystal add-on indicator shows a progress bar as well.


Save files are not affected!
